icm_lite.hypothesis: Single-file small-scope tasks suffer net negative ROI from 5-stage ceremony; collapsing to one stage eliminates planning overhead while preserving diff-only discipline.
changes_from_prev: Collapse 5 stage files into a single execution stage
Omit AST map injection for low-LOC single-file targets

icm_v1.hypothesis: Explicit 5-stage contract enforces intake, planning, diff-only edits, sanitized verification, and retrospective discipline.

icm_v2.hypothesis: Removing stage-file ceremony and pre-injecting a bounded AST symbol map reduces turn count and redundant file reads while preserving correctness via Repro -> Surgical Diff -> Verify and Loop-Breaker.
changes_from_prev: Pre-inject compact AST symbol map (max 600 tokens)
Add 2-failure Loop-Breaker directive and concise test flags

icm_v3.hypothesis: Enforcing a parallel batch-first 3-turn cadence with a byte-stable static workspace prefix (file list + 1200-token AST map + detected test runner), immediate CRLF/whitespace full-write fallback, and strict parent-path/tasks/ containment fixes remaining trace leaks and maximizes prompt prefix caching.
changes_from_prev: Forbid all stage files (01_intake.md..05_retro.md) and any tasks/ writes
Enforce parallel batch-first 3-turn cadence (Turn 1 batch-read, Turn 2 <=8-line plan + parallel edits, Turn 3 detected concise test + invariant check)
Inject byte-deterministic static context prefix (file list + 1200-token AST map + detected test command)
Add immediate full-file write fallback on search/replace mismatch for files >120 LOC
Enforce strict workspace containment (no .. traversal, no missing external script calls)
